The '''sabriquet''' was a [[Music/Legends|musical]] instrument made of [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] engine parts. In appearance, it looked very similar to the [[slitherhorn]]. During the [[Boonta Eve/Legends|Boonta's Eve]] [[Boonta Eve Classic (32 BBY)/Legends|Classic]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], a group of [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] musicians in the stands played various horns, including the sabriquet.
